lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.mp (funext_iff.not.mp hne)
  have hu : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' (f := f) (g := fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have h₀ : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' fun h => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hu.continuousAt h₀)
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let B : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  have key := hg (fun x => B x • f x₀)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨B.contDiff, B.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => B x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := B.continuous.mul hu
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => B x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
    hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.mul_right B.hasCompactSupport)
  have hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := fun x => by
    rcases lt_or_ge (dist x x₀) δ with h | h
    · exact mul_nonneg B.nonneg (hδ h).le
    · rw [B.zero_of_le_dist h, zero_mul]
  have hp : 0 < ∫ x, B x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
    integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero hc hint hn
      (mul_ne_zero (B.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0)).ne' h₀.ne')
  exact lt_irrefl _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hp key.le)
